hook: Landscapers adding *snow removal* this winter: quick quiz
title: The *snow season* paperwork quiz

questions.q: You're adding plowing this winter. Does your landscaping insurance automatically cover it?
questions.why: Plowing can be treated as a different risk. Ask your agent before the first storm.

questions.q: Your policy renews in December. A property manager has your COI from spring. Are you good?
options: No, they'll want the new one
questions.why: A COI shows policy dates. After renewal, clients often ask for a fresh certificate.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.
